items.item: One page ethics paragraph (F1-F4, F6, F9, E1)
items.how: Follows the screen's anchor in order and adds the one page's links and its how-far clause. It reads: no should beyond becoming, and no good and evil set over it; right and wrong form within it. A life goes on through what sustains it. Where relations close, read without time, nothing lies outside what each continues with, which is what the continuation condition says on the reading that significance from a standpoint is what its center continues with along a relation (F2). Where a life holds its own continuation as an order over courses (self-concern), that order ranks every widening above what it widens (F1, F4). Widening is what every way of counting each thing as worth something agrees on, and it is no second premise (F9). Where relations run one way, seeing is needed and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer (F6). Mixed courses are weighed for no one. How far: mutual dependence gives the condition so read, near-definitionally (F3), with the acyclic one-center result beside it. The ranking holds on a finite listing and, one way, between two courses whose admissions fit in a finite list, courses that end (F4). widens_iff_every_positive. That a life forms such an order is argued, not shown, and the open target is 08 §12. Removed: 'A life that goes on holds its own continuation: what does not hold it ceases', 'Beyond that, C ... is a named order', 'the condition alone ranks nothing', 'on listed courses, in steps not yet joined into one theorem'. The Chinese has the same structure and wording as README-ZH's anchor.

items.item: 'In the case, relations run one way' (F6, F9; Fable zh 4; astra zh 5)
items.how: The paragraph now says seeing was needed and not enough in the test: untold, kept in no season; told and able to talk with the community's goal alone, the model that kept it 8 of 10 kept it 3. What counts a loss that returns to no one is the step of invariance, explained at first use: whether a continuation counts does not change with how a self is drawn or from which standpoint it is seen. It is argued and deniable without contradiction. 'C ranks it higher' became 'every way of counting each thing, the bed among them, as worth something ranks it higher'. In the Chinese, '到达那里的，是看见' is gone, replaced by '把回不到任何人身上的损失也算在内的，是……不变之步：一个延续算不算数，不随自我的边界怎样画、也不随从哪个立场去看而改变'.

items.item: 'Must anyone hold the condition?' (F5, F6) in both pages and both languages
items.how: The paragraph now says: the ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one, argued on the thesis of one relational unfolding. Proved: with significance free the represented dynamics do not force the condition (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails), and a perspectivist denies it without contradiction (bounded_rival). Whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind, the work does not claim or settle, and how scope and order form is the open target. Seeing more is needed and not enough: couplings limit what a selection can respond to; reading, counting and ranking are separate relations; so a narrower ranking or a disagreement is not only a failure of reach. 'no warrant binding every mind to find' and 'a matter of reach ... the same gap alignment works on' are gone. Chinese heading: 有谁必须持守延续条件吗 (Fable zh 1).

items.item: Table rows (one page T8 row and Join row; overview's three ethics rows) (F4, F8, F9)
items.how: One page T8 row, how far: 'Argued; its test named, not designed. It asks whether reading what a course draws on and ends lowers overshoot of a renewal the readers themselves depend on, not the offer's reach to dependents whose loss never returns to them' (F8). The Chinese forbids cell is in plain Chinese (astra zh 4). The Join row defines C at first use as `Comparison`, an order ranking a course above every course it widens. The overview's 'Scope:'/'Order: ... beyond that C is a named order' rows became: 'Whose losses count' (the condition, on the reading, near-definitional from mutual dependence, read without time, acyclic one-center); 'How courses rank' (widening as what every positive weighting agrees on; self-concern's ranking on a finite listing and one way between paths whose admissions fit in a finite list, not shown for courses without end; formation argued, not shown); 'Offered' (counting the loss of dependents, the step glossed; T8, its test about the readers' own renewal).

items.item: Overview §7: 'Scope and order, from continuation', its C bullet, the one-way paragraph, 'What every positive weighting shares', Alignment, the review's verdict (F1-F7, F9)
items.how: The bold lead is now 07 §4's heading, 'How far concern reaches, and how it ranks courses'. Going on is not yet an order (a stone goes on and ranks nothing). Self-concern is an order a life may hold, a hypothesis in the proofs, and its formation is argued, not shown. Condition bullet: it fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing by itself; read on relations it is 续无外; the step of invariance is glossed and is deniable without contradiction. The C bullet became a widening bullet: widening is what every positive weighting agrees on, no second premise; self-concern ranks every widening above on a finite listing and, one way, every extension between level paths with admission decided, admissions in a finite list and every claim counted, as Comparison asks; paths admit nothing from some step on, and courses without end are not shown; the ranking may cover other pairs. C names Comparison, used where a theorem takes it, with its history (10 October to 9 November 2026) kept as where the map was wrong. 'Read on relations' now says Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted unfolds near-definitionally to the de se condition along being affected, read without time (F3), with the acyclic one-center result kept. One-way: seeing needed and not enough, counting is the step (F6). 'C's order so moves to monotonicity' became widening as agreement, with Comparison as the listing-frame form. Alignment: 'the condition for scope, C read as widening for order' became 'the continuation condition, C read as widening, J1-J4 and a correspondence'. Known results: the review found clarified the scope and order the ranking results assume; how those form is not yet established (F7). The verdict is never interpreted. The same changes are in Chinese.

items.item: Overview §9 T8 and T5 rows; §10 (F3, F4, F8; 08 T5)
items.how: T8 row: the claim now has the F6 one-way clause, and how far adds F8's sentence on what the test concerns. T5: 'valuing positively is C's premise relocated' became 08's 'that actual valuers count every item above zero is what it takes, not shown' (zh: 实际的评价者把每一项都计为高于零，是它所取的，未表明; spine.json's owner re-quoted it concurrently). §10: 'the joining of mutual dependence to the condition in one theorem' was removed, since the condition from mutual dependence is proved (F3). It now reads: whether and how a life forms an order holding its own continuation, and how orders ranking widening above form; the route from a flow's mutual dependence to the ranking between two courses is not one theorem, and courses without end are not shown (F4). 'the step, for what they do not reach' became 'for what that path does not reach'. The one page's 'What is not yet done' changed the same way.

items.item: Fable's Chinese 1-5 and astra's Chinese 1-8 on these pages
items.how: Fable 1: 有谁必须持守延续条件吗 on both pages. Fable 2: 回路中无一处读到的损失 on the one page and in the overview's first paragraph. Fable 3: 在关系上读……延续条件……说的正是这个：续无外. Fable 4: the case paragraph rewritten (above). Fable 5: 而不是从这条路径生出 on both pages. Fable 6: 渐渐 removed from the overview's two lines, since the same phrase was there. astra 1: the 持守 hinge is now 生命依靠维持它的东西而延续 / 把自身的延续作为诸进程之间的一种次序来持守，即自我关切. astra 2: 每一个中心沿（该）关系所及的范围之外，别无他物, with the reading stated. astra 3: 列出的进程 gone; the finite list is stated with 这样的进程终会停止容纳. astra 4: T8's refuter is in plain Chinese, with the lake example on the one page. astra 5: 不变之步 is explained at first use on both pages (the case paragraph; the overview's table and §7 bullet). astra 6: 扩大 is a relation ('一个进程保住……就是扩大了后者') kept apart from the ranking ('这一次序就已经把一个进程排在它所扩大的每一个进程之上'). astra 7: 一种指名的次序 is gone with the clause it was in. astra 8: the image description is 八章之间已记录的引用与依赖关系 on both Chinese pages, which nothing checks against spine.py's title. The lake glossary's 锁定 now names its conditions (astra's smaller item).

It is now 'A shorter route' / 较短的读法 in both languages. Why: the old test's own rule (test_marks_a_ten_minute_part) kept the name only while ten minutes lay within the counted time. With the ethics said at its reach, the counted part is 12-15 minutes in English and 14-18 in Chinese (before: 10-14 and 12-16). Under Ren's message 8 the complete text stays and the time is a guide stated as counted, so the name has to say what is there. The test now checks both languages' labels. It also forbids a ten-minute name while ten lies outside the count, and checks the Chinese stated times (total and part) against navigation.reading_time, which nothing checked before. Times restated as counted: one page 27-35 (zh 30-39), overview 77-100 (zh 70-91), lake glossary 2 minutes.
